It carries the reader from the completed punishment report in 71:25 into a new quoted prayer, so the request is heard as the next discourse act after consequence. Because the particle stands visibly before {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}), relation is marked before the speech event itself: the narrative turns from third-person outcome into direct prophetic address.

words.prose: {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}) makes the prayer itself the narrated event: the verb does not summarize an inner judgment but introduces a direct quoted supplication. Its perfect active Form I gives a plain completed speech entry, while the whole vocative and negative request becomes its complement. The delayed subject {{ar:نُوحٌ}} ({{tr:nūḥun}}) assigns the utterance to the named prophet after the act of saying has already arrived, so the speech is both foregrounded and accountable. Against the wider speech-root family, the local form avoids imputed or reciprocal speech; the force lies in what is quoted. Its firm consonantal opening gives the quoted act a marked acoustic entry before the softer named appeal. Within the surah, the same speech frame recalls earlier Noah-address scenes such as 71:5 and turns the repeated speech pattern into the final petition.

words.prose: {{ar:رَبِّ}} ({{tr:rabbi}}) compresses the address: the vocative particle is absent, but the form still functions as direct appeal. The first-person relation makes the request personal, while the title's lordship field makes the addressee the one able to govern what remains on earth. The wider root range of ownership, mastery, nurture, and regulation matters because the petition concerns survival and habitation, but the local form is a noun-title rather than a finite nurturing verb. Variant {{ar:رَبُّ}} ({{tr:rabbu}}) exposes a case-pressure around title and address without changing the divine addressee or the following request. The short address then releases into the clipped {{ar:لَا تَذَرْ}} ({{tr:lā tadhar}}), so appeal turns quickly into non-leaving command. In the surah's prayer pattern, especially from 71:5 onward, this title is the stable axis from complaint to final exclusion.

That span matters: the full totality becomes visible only when {{ar:دَيَّارًا}} ({{tr:dayyāran}}) arrives at the end. Its separate placement before the clipped jussive makes the scope boundary visible and gives the request an audible halt before the leaving verb.

words.prose: {{ar:تَذَرْ}} ({{tr:tadhar}}) is the action the prayer asks the Lord to block: leaving, or allowing to remain. Its second-person jussive form makes future residual survival the issue, not a past act already complete. The root pressure is sharper than ordinary abandonment: the request targets what could be left behind after judgment, a surviving carrier of denial. Its clipped jussive close tightens the verb at the point where remaining is being denied. Its dependents extend the verb across {{ar:عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:ʿalā al-arḍi}}), {{ar:مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ}} ({{tr:mina al-kāfirīna}}), and {{ar:دَيَّارًا}} ({{tr:dayyāran}}), so place, class, and final person all sit inside one non-leaving request. The same root reverses 71:23, where the people insist that their gods not be left; here Noah asks that the idol-preservers themselves not be left, and 71:27 explains why survival would reproduce misguidance.

words.prose: {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) makes the earth phrase a governed surface-domain, not loose scenery. It attaches {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-arḍi}}) to {{ar:تَذَرْ}} ({{tr:tadhar}}), so the request concerns disbelieving presence upon an inhabited domain. Its broader range can include overness and burden, but local grammar selects surface-location while leaving the pressure of habitation lying upon the domain. The recited link between particle and earth noun reinforces that they function as one locative unit. Because this phrase comes before the class and final object, the listener first imagines the surface to be cleared before the last person is named.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-arḍi}}) names the known inhabited domain under {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}), not the direct object of the leaving verb. Its definiteness and singular form make the domain unified and familiar, while the final {{ar:دَيَّارًا}} ({{tr:dayyāran}}) lets that domain widen toward total inhabited ground. The root range includes land, ground, territory, and earth, but local grammar and the dweller-word select embodied surface-presence. In the surah's earth sequence, the domain that received and spread humans in 71:17 and 71:19 becomes the domain that must no longer host disbelieving continuity in 71:26. The word is not neutral scenery: it is the arena where denial has visible consequence, and even the hamza onset helps the domain noun stand out between the leaving verb and the human object. The word comes before class and individual, so space itself is imagined as cleared before the remaining person is named.

words.prose: {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) is the hinge that turns the clause from surface-domain to condemned class. After {{ar:عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:ʿalā al-arḍi}}), it binds {{ar:ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ}} ({{tr:al-kāfirīna}}) into the scope of the final {{ar:دَيَّارًا}} ({{tr:dayyāran}}), so the request is class-specific rather than anti-human in general. The phrase can work partitivally, from among that class, and explanatorily, specifying what kind of dweller is excluded; attachment evidence keeps it with the final object rather than as a second location. Its nasal opening leads directly into the class noun, audibly binding the function word to what it restricts. Its position before the final indefinite noun makes condemned identity govern the last possible survivor before that survivor is heard.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ}} ({{tr:al-kāfirīna}}) is a definite plural active participle governed by {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}), so it names the restricted pool from which any possible {{ar:دَيَّارًا}} ({{tr:dayyāran}}) is excluded. The active participle form makes the target a practiced identity of denial or covering, not an abstract state and not a momentary lapse. The root's covering and concealment image remains meaningful, but local grammar keeps it as the class identity inside the non-leaving construction; set under the Lord-address, that covering stands against rightful authority. Its plural ending keeps the class open before the final singular noun, and the cadence moves from definite plural class to the heavy last remnant. The root echo into 71:27, where intensified rejection is named as the generational outcome, explains why the class on earth is treated as a reproductive danger.

words.prose: {{ar:دَيَّارًا}} ({{tr:dayyāran}}) is the delayed direct object, and under {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) its indefiniteness yields not even one dweller from the class. The heavy rare form does more than say person: it selects a person-present sense from the dwelling and circling field, so the request bars settled homes, roaming remnants, and social continuity together. The class phrase {{ar:مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ}} ({{tr:mina al-kāfirīna}}) keeps the exclusion morally restricted, while the earlier {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-arḍi}}) makes the final word answer a place-domain with an inhabitant. Because the ayah ends here, the last heard word is the last imaginable survivor; the doubled sound and final indefinite cadence make that survivor hard to miss. That repeated indefinite accusative cadence also links the no-helpers closure of 71:25 with the no-inhabitant closure here. The forward bridge to 71:27 turns even one inhabitant into a generational risk.

baseline_models.mechanism: Sovereign address, the operator of leaving, terrestrial scope, truth-covering affiliation, and the place-attached resident converge on a request for zero remaining members of that resident class.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech makes the request an explicit act rather than an unvoiced wish.
Lordship and authority identify the addressee as the one who decides what remains.
Leaving or letting be supplies the retention operator that the negation cancels.
The lower ground opposite the sky gives the request its complete terrestrial field.
Covering or rejecting truth defines the class whose continued residence is denied.
Attachment to a residence supplies the concrete image of even one remaining inhabitant.

changed_reading.before: A bare wish that nobody be left.
changed_reading.after: A formally voiced appeal to sovereign authority that not one earth-attached resident of the truth-covering class remain.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: الْأَرْضِ, الْكَافِرِينَ, and دَيَّارًا bind ground, covering, and residence.
baseline_models.mechanism: Fertile ground, seed-covering, and attachment to a dwelling form a material analogy in which concealment is not only an opinion but something lodged in an inhabited substrate.

activation_trace.role: Soft fertile ground supplies the substrate in which a covered thing can remain lodged.
Covering seed gives concealment a latent, materially embedded image.
The resident attached to a place turns that embedded concealment into a habitation pattern.

changed_reading.before: The verse removes people carrying a doctrinal label.
changed_reading.after: The verse asks that settled concealment no longer remain implanted in the inhabited earth.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negated leaving of any دَيَّار is read through the circular range of د و ر.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ordinary resident sense remains primary, while the branch image of circulation adds a systems-level possibility: leaving even one resident would leave one carrier through which the same state could turn again.

activation_trace.role: Leaving something in place supplies the survival condition for a continuing circuit.
Truth-covering supplies the state that could be carried forward.
Turning and encircling supply the image of recurrence beyond the literal resident.

changed_reading.after: No surviving carrier should remain through whom the truth-covering circuit can turn again.

context_deltas.mechanism: Calling reaches the group repeatedly and through public and private registers, but they install their own cover against reception. The focus class therefore reads less like an inherited label and more like a maintained access-blocking shell whose residents carry it forward.

activation_trace.role: Calling by speech supplies the attempted communicative access.
A cover laid over the self supplies the mechanism that blocks that access.
Raised public speech shows that overt delivery was tried.
Hidden or inward address shows that private delivery was also tried.
Covering truth names the stabilized result of repeated access refusal.
The resident image makes each remaining person a durable carrier of that shell.

structural_cues: 71:5-9 varies night and day, repeated calling, overt declaration, and secrecy.
71:7 places bodily hearing barriers and clothing between the call and its recipients.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exhaustive delivery modes and self-covering refusal; I infer that persistence through every access mode converts an episode of disbelief into a self-maintaining shell. A live alternative is that the sequence only documents intensity of refusal without defining the focus class mechanistically.

changed_reading.before: Remove all residents identified as disbelievers.
changed_reading.after: After every channel of address has been met by an actively maintained shell, leave no resident carrier through whom that shell can persist.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier delay is bounded by a fixed term that cannot be deferred once it arrives, and drowning is narrated immediately before the petition. The focus request can therefore function as closure at an already reached endpoint: no remnant is to be carried beyond the completed adverse turn.

activation_trace.role: Deferral to a later time supplies the temporary interval before closure.
The fixed temporal limit supplies the endpoint beyond which delay cannot extend.
Arrival supplies the transition from available delay to realized endpoint.
Drowning as lethal action marks the adverse endpoint as already realized in the narrative sequence.
The leave operator now concerns whether any remainder crosses the endpoint.
The adverse turn or defeat gives the resident's removal a terminal rather than initiating role.

structural_cues: 71:4 says the appointed term is not delayed once it comes.
71:25 uses completed passive actions before 71:26 reports Noah's speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bounded delay, arrival, and completed drowning before the focus speech; I infer that the prayer ratifies total closure rather than initiating an unbounded catastrophe. A live alternative is that narrative order is rhetorical and does not fix the speech's chronology.

changed_reading.before: No disbelieving inhabitant should be left from this moment onward.
changed_reading.after: At the non-deferrable endpoint already displayed, let no resident remnant be carried past the completed judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The leaders' voiced command uses the same leave/retain operator to preserve named cult objects; Noah's voiced command turns that operator back on the command's human carriers. The prayer becomes a formal counter-imperative that ends the preservation system by removing its resident maintainers.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech frames the earlier preservation slogan as an explicit command.
Repeated leaving or abandoning supplies the exact retention operator later reversed in the focus.
The named worshipped idol supplies one concrete object the earlier command protects.
A second named idol confirms that the command organizes continued cultic retention.
Noah's uttered speech supplies the answering command frame.
The same leave operator is redirected from protected objects to their resident protectors.
The place-attached resident identifies the human infrastructure whose retention would preserve the cult.

structural_cues: 71:23 repeats لَا تَذَرُنَّ around a list of named objects; 71:26 answers with لَا تَذَرْ.
Both commands are introduced by forms of قَالَ, making the reversal formally audible.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies matched speech frames, the repeated leave verb, and the shift from cult objects to disbelieving residents; I infer a deliberate counter-preservation structure. A live alternative is simple lexical repetition without a formal reversal mechanism.

changed_reading.after: Reverse their command to preserve the cult: leave none of the resident human maintainers who could keep that preservation order in force.

context_deltas.mechanism: Humans are figured as growth from earth, return into it, and renewed extraction; the later conditional adds offspring generated from the existing population and labels the output with concealment. The focus combination of fertile earth, covered seed, and circulation can therefore ask for interruption of a terrestrial-social regeneration circuit, not only removal of current adults.

activation_trace.role: Human growth and nurture supply the first stage of a terrestrial generation model.
Return after departure supplies the circuit's inward movement back into earth.
Passage to the outside supplies the circuit's renewed outward movement.
Something produced from something else connects biological succession to continued social output.
Seed-covering gives the predicted offspring a latent recurrence image.
Fertile earth anchors the circuit in the focus verse's own spatial substrate.
Leaving even one carrier supplies the condition under which succession could continue.
Circular movement supplies the systems image that joins return, emergence, and succession.

structural_cues: 71:17-18 gives a compact growth, return, and extraction sequence centered on earth.
71:27 makes leaving the present group causally antecedent to both misleading and future birth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an earth-return-extraction sequence and a separate birth-to-concealment prediction; I infer that one remaining resident can couple the biological and social cycles. A live alternative keeps resurrection imagery and ordinary genealogy as separate mechanisms.

changed_reading.before: Remove every currently living disbelieving inhabitant.
changed_reading.after: Break the earth-linked succession circuit at its remaining resident nodes so that concealment is not generated again.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earth is spread as traversable surface and articulated by entered routes, extended ways, and wide passes. Against that network, عَلَى الْأَرْضِ and دَيَّارًا become a spatial saturation claim: no settled or circulating node anywhere in the habitable route system is exempt.

activation_trace.role: Spread earth as a carpet supplies a continuous habitable surface.
Penetrating a route supplies movement through that surface.
The extended traveled road supplies the network's connective edges.
Wide open mountain passes expand the network beyond a single settlement.
The focus earth receives the network-wide scope built by the context.
The place-attached resident supplies the settlement node distributed over that network.

structural_cues: 71:19-20 moves from the whole spread earth to the purpose of traversing its broad ways.
The focus repeats earth and adds the exhaustive singular دَيَّارًا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies spread surface, traversal, routes, and passes; I infer a settlement-and-mobility network over which the focus negation ranges. A live alternative is that these verses only amplify geographic scope without changing the resident reading.

changed_reading.before: Not one inhabitant should remain in an unspecified place.
changed_reading.after: Across the whole traversable settlement network of the spread earth, no resident node or mobile remainder is outside the request's scope.

context_deltas.mechanism: The predicted offspring line is followed by a prayer for protective forgiveness covering Noah, parents, believing entrants, and believing men and women. The focus is thereby bounded by a selective habitation rule: the disbelieving resident line is denied continuation while a faith-defined household of entry and kinship is positively retained.

activation_trace.role: Offspring from a lineage supplies the negative continuity that the focus request interrupts.
Protective covering of fault supplies the positive preservation requested for the contrasting group.
Entry into an interior supplies a membership threshold rather than an ethnic boundary.
Household and family supply the positive social container opposed to the excluded resident class.
Security and trusting calm supply the criterion shared by entrant and wider believing community.
Truth-covering marks the specifically excluded affiliation rather than humanity as such.
The place-attached resident becomes one side of a contrasted habitation membership rule.

structural_cues: 71:26 restricts the negated residents with مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ.
71:28 immediately names parents, a believing house entrant, believing men, and believing women as recipients of forgiveness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an excluded resident class followed by protected kin, entrant, and faith classes; I infer that the prayer redraws household membership rather than seeking undifferentiated human absence. A live alternative treats the house reference as a separate personal prayer with no spatial answer to دَيَّارًا.

changed_reading.before: The verse sounds like an undifferentiated request for depopulation.
changed_reading.after: The verse denies continuity to one truth-covering resident line while the next prayer positively preserves a permeable, faith-defined household and community.

context_deltas.mechanism: One ayah juxtaposes an offered protective covering of fault with the hearers' chosen covering of themselves; later they are comprehensively covered by water. The focus root ك ف ر then sits inside a sequence of rival covering regimes: sheltering forgiveness refused, obstructive covering adopted, engulfing covering incurred.

activation_trace.role: Covering fault while protecting its bearer supplies the offered beneficial covering.
A self-applied upper cover supplies the obstructive covering chosen instead.
Comprehensive engulfment supplies the terminal physical covering.
Covering and concealment anchor the three-stage reversal in the focus class name.
The ground opposite the sky marks the surface from which the engulfed coverers are not to reappear as residents.

structural_cues: 71:7 contains both the purpose لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ and their act of covering themselves.
71:25 moves from their faults to comprehensive drowning before 71:26 names الْكَافِرِينَ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three materially different coverings; I infer a reversal from refused protection through chosen obstruction to imposed engulfment. A live alternative is that the shared covering imagery is analogical and the drowning sequence is causally independent of the lexical branch.

changed_reading.before: Kāfirīn is a static designation for the people to be removed.
changed_reading.after: The focus closes a covering trajectory: those who refused protective covering and installed obstructive covering have been engulfed, and no carrier of that regime is to remain on earth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because دَيَّار normally activates the resident branch, while the ritual-circling branch belongs to the wider د و ر inventory. It remains anchored in the focus word and is activated by the immediately preceding command to preserve named idols. Downstream prose should present it only as a cultic-orbit overlay, never as the lexical translation of دَيَّارًا.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: دَيَّارًا can weakly echo the ritual-circling branch of د و ر beside its primary resident sense.

activation_trace.role: The command not to abandon supplies the act that keeps a cultic orbit operating.
A named worshipped idol supplies the center around which preservation is organized.
A second idol confirms that the preceding system has multiple cultic centers.
A place or object circled in ritual supplies the exploratory orbit image inside the focus anchor.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, leave no human remainder capable of continuing the ritual orbit around the preserved cult objects.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This uses the packet's non-dominant ق و ل to ق ل ل mapping and is therefore deliberately form-distant: قَالَ still means spoke. It remains inspectably anchored in the focus speech verb and gains force from the surah's repeated increase formulas. Downstream prose should describe it as a branch-triggered sound or performative echo of decrease, not as morphology or translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: وَقَالَ is branch-mapped non-dominantly to the fewness image of ق ل ل.

activation_trace.role: Increase and growth supply the repeated operation that Noah's focus speech counteracts.
A later increase formula confirms that additive change structures the surrounding discourse.
Fewness and smallness turn the utterance into an exploratory performative image of subtraction.
Negated leaving supplies the operation by which the remainder is reduced to none.

changed_reading.before: The speech frame merely reports that Noah spoke.
changed_reading.after: As a contained branch echo, Noah's saying performs a counter-increase, asking that the remaining population be reduced from fewness to zero.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain material model linking promised rain and rivers to later engulfment, then reading fertile earth, seed-covering, and circulation in the focus as concern about what follows the reset. It remains anchored in الْأَرْضِ, الْكَافِرِينَ, and دَيَّارًا, but the packet does not explicitly state that blessing-water becomes flood-water. Downstream prose should mark that hydraulic reversal as reader inference rather than narrative identity.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Fertile الْأَرْضِ, seed-covering الْكَافِرِينَ, and circular دَيَّارًا receive a water-cycle activation.

activation_trace.role: Abundant outflow from a source supplies provisioned water entering the terrestrial system.
A river cutting earth with flowing water supplies the productive channel state.
Comprehensive engulfment supplies the same material in an annihilating saturation state.
Fertile earth supplies the substrate altered by either productive flow or saturation.
Covered seed supplies the latent post-water possibility of renewed growth.
Circulation supplies the possibility that the terrestrial system could begin another turn.

changed_reading.before: The flood removes the present inhabitants and the prayer asks for completeness.
changed_reading.after: After water reverses from provision to total saturation, the prayer asks that the reset earth contain no latent resident seed from which the same covering system can turn again.

strongest_changes: The exact leave-command used to preserve the idols is reversed against the resident humans who preserve them.
The prayer reads as terminal closure at a previously announced non-deferrable term, not simply as initiation of punishment.
Earthly growth, return, extraction, and later birth turn zero survivors into interruption of a terrestrial-social regeneration circuit.
The following prayer for believing kin and house entrants makes the requested absence a selective habitation boundary rather than undifferentiated depopulation.
summary.what_was_special: The focus verse became most active where its compact leave, earth, covering, and resident vocabulary was replayed as command reversal, temporal closure, household sorting, and material circulation. The same branch images support several coexisting mechanisms without requiring one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the circular and ritual ranges of د و ر should remain overlays on the primary resident sense or influence rendered prose at all.
Whether the earth-return sequence and the birth prediction are intended as one regeneration mechanism or only become coupled by reader inference.
Whether the placement of completed drowning before the focus speech establishes chronology or serves a rhetorical ordering.
Whether the protective, obstructive, and engulfing coverings form a deliberate sequence or only a productive branch-level analogy.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The prayer asks that no truth-covering resident remain attached to earth.** **و ذ ر B003** supplies leaving or letting remain, **ء ر ض B001** earth, **ك ف ر B003** covering or rejecting truth, and **د و ر B007** a person attached to residence. **د و ر B008** also contains the idiom “not a soul there,” directly activated by the negated *dayyāran*. The packet supplies location, resident attachment, and non-remainder; the abductive arrow is that the prayer targets the continuing terrestrial seat of rejection. The ayah reads as removal of an inhabiting system, not an abstract curse detached from place.

2. **The prior preservation-command is reversed.** In 71:23 leaders twice command “do not leave” through **و ذ ر B003** so worshipped objects remain; Noah now uses the same root in a prayer that no rejecter remain. The packet supplies the exact lexical reversal. The inferred relation is a conflict over what is to be preserved on earth: rival worship and its carriers, or the created order’s proper orientation. The ayah answers their preservation formula with a counter-formula of non-preservation.

3. **A broken cycle must stop circulating.** **د و ر B003** supplies circulation of states and management of affairs, while **B004** supplies an adverse turn enclosing a group. Birth in 71:27 explains why a single surviving resident would continue the cycle. The packet supplies circulation, residence, and reproduction; the abductive arrow is that removal is requested to interrupt a self-reproducing adverse turn. *Dayyāran* thus gains a temporal-cyclical undertone beside its resident scope.

4. **The cultivator image is inverted.** **ك ف ر B008** supplies the farmer who covers seed with soil; 71:17 described humans as earth-grown plants. The direct human category remains rejection through **B003**. The inferred contrast is that those cultivated from earth have become cultivators of concealment, covering truth as seed is covered but producing the corrupt growth described in 71:27. This reading ties the prayer to the surah’s ecology.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 71:27 supplied the unstated reason a single resident matters: social misguidance and birth would keep the adverse cycle circulating. 71:28 then corrected the scope by distinguishing a believing household and lineage from the rejected reproductive system.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Removing the remaining reproduction-node.** **Lexical evidence:** `و ذ ر B003` is leaving or letting remain; `د و ر B008` includes the idiom “not a soul there” and forms traced to house/residence. **Structural cue:** `دَيَّارًا` is followed at 71:27 by the explicit claim that leaving them enables misguidance and further birth. **Assigned role:** even one resident can be a household-bearing node from which the system regrows. **Abductive move:** the packet states the leaving-to-misguidance/birth arrow in the next ayah; I infer that this explains the exhaustive singular here. **Reading change:** `ديارا` denotes continuity-capacity, not bare headcount.

2. **Truth-covering as a transmissible system.** **Lexical evidence:** `ك ف ر B003` is covering or rejecting truth, with `ك ف ر B001` retaining the concrete cover image; 71:23 supplies a command to preserve worshipped names. **Structural cue:** the category `الكافرين` stands between institutional retention and the reproductive conditional of 71:27. **Assigned role:** covering truth is maintained through command, residence, and generation. **Abductive move:** I infer transmission from the sequence; the packet does not claim biological inheritance. **Reading change:** the people are identified by an active social practice of concealment that can reproduce itself.

3. **The reversed “do not leave.”** **Lexical evidence:** `و ذ ر B003` recurs from the leaders' doubled prohibition in 71:23. **Structural cue:** they refuse to abandon objects; Noah asks that the agents of that refusal not be left. **Assigned role:** the same verb exposes opposed preservation projects. **Abductive move:** I infer deliberate reversal from lexical recurrence. **Reading change:** the prayer answers cultic conservation with a request to terminate its human maintenance chain.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The next ayah explicitly confirmed why the singular `دَيَّارًا` carries system-level weight: one remaining resident can misdirect existing servants and generate continuity. The house of trusting entrants at 71:28 then provided a countermodel in which residence transmits security and assent instead.

baseline.text: Nuh dedi ki: Rabbim, yeryüzünde inkâr edenlerden tek bir kişi bırakma.

findings.text: Tek bir yerleşik kişinin bile bırakılmaması isteği, sonraki saptırma ve doğurma gerekçesiyle, her haneyi düzenin yeniden büyüyebileceği bir devamlılık düğümü haline getirir.
İnkârın örtme çağrışımı, önceki ilahları koruma buyruğu ile sonraki doğum şartı arasında, hakikati örten uygulamanın toplumsal olarak aktarılabildiğini gösterir.
Önderlerin 'ilahlarınızı bırakmayın' sözüne aynı kökle 'inkâr edenlerden kimseyi bırakma' diye karşılık verilmesi, birbirine karşıt iki koruma projesini açığa çıkarır.
Yerleşik kişi kökündeki dolaşım ve grubu kuşatan kötü dönüş çağrışımları, tek kişinin kalmasının kendi kendini üreten olumsuz çevrimi sürdürebileceğini düşündürür.
İnkâr eden kişideki tohumu toprakla örten çiftçi çağrışımı, yerden bitki gibi yetişen insanın hakikati örten bozuk bir ürün yetiştiricisine dönüşmesi benzetmesini önerir.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 71:15-28] Human Life Is Planted, Returned, and Raised
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Human existence follows a cultivated cycle of placement in earth, growth, return, and renewed emergence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Agriculture, burial, education, and biological descent become phases of one generative process.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The earth is a growing medium for human formation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A cultivator places living material in receptive ground, tends it, and brings a formed human subject to maturity.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: soft fertile earth (`quranic:root_000025:B002/m01`); plant emerging from ground (`quranic:root_001465:B001/m01`); deliberate planting (`quranic:root_001465:B002/m01`); source and growing site (`quranic:root_001465:B005/m01`); human growth and upbringing (`quranic:root_001465:B006/m01`); grain spike extending from the stalk (`quranic:root_000672:B008/m01`); tree flower as emitted light (`quranic:root_001564:B004/m01`); seed covered by soil (`quranic:root_001307:B008/m01`); fruit enclosed in its sheath (`quranic:root_001307:B010/m01`); origination (`quranic:root_000434:B002/m01`); gradual repair and completion (`quranic:root_000532:B002/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Earth supplies setting and material receptivity; planting supplies agency; seed-covering supplies protected latency; and upbringing extends cultivation into human care. “Growing you” therefore remains biologically, pedagogically, and spiritually active.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: return after departure (`quranic:root_001058:B001/m01`); place and time of return (`quranic:root_001058:B002/m01`); repeated visitation of the sick or mourning place (`quranic:root_001058:B005/m01`); benefit that returns to its recipient (`quranic:root_001058:B006/m01`); ancient return-road (`quranic:root_001058:B009/m01`); entering a place or state (`quranic:root_000464:B001/m01`); penetration to the outside (`quranic:root_000400:B001/m01`); extraction from concealment (`quranic:root_000400:B002/m01`); grave as a house (`quranic:root_000166:B007/m01`); remote village or grave (`quranic:root_001307:B012/m01`); disappearance into earth (`quranic:root_000913:B002/m01`); clinging to the ground (`quranic:root_000025:B006/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Return, entry, disappearance, grave-house, extraction, and exit form one reversible spatial sequence. Earth is not merely the place of disposal; it is the prior source and temporary interior from which renewed outward movement is possible.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 71:15-28] Prepared Ground Becomes Route, Dwelling, and Contested Residence
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Space is made usable by spreading, opening, traversing, and inhabiting it; judgment then contests who may remain and who may enter a protected house.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The earth-carpet is not passive scenery but civic infrastructure whose routes lead either to inhabited refuge or to an emptied settlement.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: House, household, and resident define protected belonging
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A dwelling shelters a recognized household and admits a trusted entrant into its interior.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: shelter and dwelling (`quranic:root_000166:B001/m01`); household and dependents (`quranic:root_000166:B002/m01`); house of inherited standing (`quranic:root_000166:B008/m01`); entry into an interior (`quranic:root_000464:B001/m01`); inward confidential domain (`quranic:root_000464:B003/m01`); outsider incorporated among a people (`quranic:root_000464:B005/m01`); settled householder or resident (`quranic:root_000499:B007/m01`); security and trustworthy belonging (`quranic:root_000054:B001/m01`); faith as heart-settling assent (`quranic:root_000054:B002/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Belonging is built through shelter, kin relation, recognized standing, admission, and trust. Entry is not generic movement; it crosses a social boundary into an interior whose members are secured by a shared assent.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 71:15-28] Prepared Ground Becomes Route, Dwelling, and Contested Residence

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The prayer's resident is not just an isolated individual. Dwelling, fixed attachment, settlement, and hostile encirclement make residence a durable claim; leaving and breaking reverse it. The prepared earth can therefore move from hospitable infrastructure to a territory deliberately cleared of a destructive occupancy.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 71:15-28] Following Converts Increase Into Multiplying Loss
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Allegiance propagates a governing direction, so assets and descendants amplify either ordered life or the loss already embedded in their leader.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Loss behaves like a bad balance sheet and a reproductive process: capital, claims, speech, followers, and offspring all enlarge the same deficit.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Following transfers another's direction and liability
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A follower places movement, judgment, and consequence behind a leader, allowing one direction to become a succession.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: following person, command, or trace (`quranic:root_000175:B001/m01`); catching what went ahead (`quranic:root_000175:B002/m01`); tracing an effect step by step (`quranic:root_000175:B003/m01`); uninterrupted succession (`quranic:root_000175:B004/m01`); liability that follows an act (`quranic:root_000175:B006/m01`); rulers succeeding one another (`quranic:root_000175:B009/m01`); ordered and proportionate execution (`quranic:root_000175:B012/m01`); departure from obedience or group (`quranic:root_000400:B006/m01`); departure from obedience (`quranic:root_001022:B001/m01`); ruling speaker whose word takes effect (`quranic:root_001272:B004/m01`); circulating public saying (`quranic:root_001272:B007/m01`); negotiation over an affair (`quranic:root_001272:B009/m01`); imposing judgment on another (`quranic:root_001272:B010/m01`); professed creed or position (`quranic:root_001272:B013/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Following is simultaneously motion, succession, and transferred consequence. The leader's operative word supplies direction; the follower catches and continues it; and liability trails the sequence. Disobedience can therefore become organized rather than merely individual.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 71:15-28] Following Converts Increase Into Multiplying Loss
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Allegiance propagates a governing direction, so assets and descendants amplify either ordered life or the loss already embedded in their leader.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Loss behaves like a bad balance sheet and a reproductive process: capital, claims, speech, followers, and offspring all enlarge the same deficit.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Error reproduces itself through numbers and generation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Misguidance spreads across a crowd and then through offspring, turning a present deviation into a durable lineage.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: deviation from path and guidance (`quranic:root_000913:B001/m01`); loss of the thing or its location (`quranic:root_000913:B003/m01`); failed retention and memory (`quranic:root_000913:B004/m01`); increase and accretion (`quranic:root_000657:B001/m01`); multiplication of number (`quranic:root_001286:B001/m01`); new human generation (`quranic:root_001465:B003/m01`); childbirth (`quranic:root_001683:B003/m01`); derivative generated from a prior source (`quranic:root_001683:B005/m01`); transgressive rupture (`quranic:root_001132:B004/m01`); covering and denial of truth (`quranic:root_001307:B003/m01`); coercion into disobedience (`quranic:root_001307:B007/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The process has both horizontal and vertical propagation. Deviation spreads through many contemporaries, then childbirth and derivation carry it into another generation. Forgetting and loss show how guidance disappears from transmission, while coercion explains how a formed social system can make later disobedience easier.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 71:15-28] The Plot Is Cultivated Beneath a Treated Surface
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A destructive plan develops through hidden preparation, managed inputs, and a surface that conceals the condition of what is ripening underneath.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Plotting becomes an agricultural and cosmetic operation: water the hard ground, grow the plant, coat the exterior, and discover rot in the fruit.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Concealed defect is covered by a persuasive finish
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An internal fault is held beneath an applied surface that improves appearance while obscuring what lies inside.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: inward corruption, deceit, and hostility (`quranic:root_000464:B004/m01`); concealed interior and confidence (`quranic:root_000464:B003/m01`); interpenetrating internal parts (`quranic:root_000464:B008/m01`); planning and arranging by night (`quranic:root_000166:B004/m01`); chief share of a great affair (`quranic:root_001281:B002/m01`); ochre coating (`quranic:root_001438:B004/m01`); cosmetic plaster or depilatory coating (`quranic:root_001564:B009/m01`); covering and concealment (`quranic:root_001307:B001/m01`); denial that hides truth (`quranic:root_001307:B003/m01`); visible appearance or mirror (`quranic:root_000531:B006/m01`).

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 71:15-28] Cult Objects Bind Affection to Fabrication and Predation

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The cult object moves from plastered artifact and cherished name to beak, claw, thief, and raiding detachment.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The object has maker, material, name, theological status, and ritual use. The scene sharply distinguishes manufactured centrality from inherent divinity.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Beak, stripping action, troop, and thief share a single predatory invariant at increasing scales. Fraudulent play and false report provide social tools for the same seizure. The idol that is cherished as a protector is lexically reframed as an extraction system.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 71:15-28] Covering Divides Denial, Burial, and Mercy
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Covering changes what remains available to sight, memory, consequence, or protection; its moral force depends on what is covered and for what end.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Seed-cover, truth-cover, grave, flood, expiation, and forgiveness are materially similar operations with opposed outcomes.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Denial covers truth and benefit at their source
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A subject places a screen over disclosed truth and over the benefit already received, preventing acknowledgment from reaching either.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: general covering (`quranic:root_001307:B001/m01`); denial and concealment of truth (`quranic:root_001307:B003/m01`); covering a benefit by ingratitude (`quranic:root_001307:B004/m01`); darkness or vast water as engulfing cover (`quranic:root_001307:B002/m01`); seed hidden by soil (`quranic:root_001307:B008/m01`); withdrawal and disavowal (`quranic:root_001307:B005/m01`); transgressive rupture of a protective boundary (`quranic:root_001132:B004/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Covering moves from physical screen to epistemic and ethical operation. Truth is made unavailable, benefit is detached from gratitude, and disavowal removes relational responsibility. Seed-cover shows that concealment can serve life, which exposes denial's distortion: it covers not to protect emergence but to prevent recognition.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 71:15-28] Covering Divides Denial, Burial, and Mercy
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Covering changes what remains available to sight, memory, consequence, or protection; its moral force depends on what is covered and for what end.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Seed-cover, truth-cover, grave, flood, expiation, and forgiveness are materially similar operations with opposed outcomes.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Engulfment hides body, route, and memory
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Water, earth, or darkness occupies the subject's whole field until location, route, and retained trace disappear.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: sinking under water to destruction (`quranic:root_001080:B001/m01`); total occupation of a field (`quranic:root_001080:B005/m01`); ground filled with water (`quranic:root_001080:B003/m01`); disappearance and burial (`quranic:root_000913:B002/m01`); loss of location (`quranic:root_000913:B003/m01`); loss from memory (`quranic:root_000913:B004/m01`); remote grave or settlement (`quranic:root_001307:B012/m01`); lower realm beneath another (`quranic:root_000502:B001/m01`); entering an enclosing state (`quranic:root_000464:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 71:18 (`خ ر ج` as the counter-operation); 71:24 and 71:27 (`ض ل ل`); 71:25 (`غ ر ق`, `د خ ل`, `د و ن`); 71:26-27 (`ك ف ر`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Immersion does more than kill. It removes coordinates, interrupts the route, suppresses the trace, and turns the surrounding medium into a total cover. The later promise of exit from earth stands as the exact counter-operation to this disappearance.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 71:15-28] Covering Divides Denial, Burial, and Mercy
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Covering changes what remains available to sight, memory, consequence, or protection; its moral force depends on what is covered and for what end.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Seed-cover, truth-cover, grave, flood, expiation, and forgiveness are materially similar operations with opposed outcomes.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Mercy covers fault while preserving the person
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A fault is covered in a way that removes its punitive effect without erasing the subject, who is instead admitted into security.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: preserving cover (`quranic:root_001096:B001/m01`); forgiveness shielding from sin's effect (`quranic:root_001096:B002/m01`); expiation that covers an offense (`quranic:root_001307:B009/m01`); security and trust (`quranic:root_000054:B001/m01`); assent that settles the heart (`quranic:root_000054:B002/m01`); prayer for response (`quranic:root_000054:B003/m01`); entering an interior (`quranic:root_000464:B001/m01`); dwelling as refuge (`quranic:root_000166:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Merciful covering preserves identity and relationship. Expiation removes the offense's operative trace, trust settles the entrant, and the house receives rather than obliterates the person. This is the opposite of engulfment: the fault disappears while the subject remains locatable and sheltered.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 71:15-28] Household Continuity Forks Into Corrupt and Believing Succession
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A household transmits identity through birth, upbringing, following, and admission; the transmitted direction can reproduce rebellion or secure trust.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Lineage is a transmission system rather than a guarantee: biological generation, fostered formation, social imitation, and house-entry can carry opposed inheritances.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Birth can reproduce an already corrupted pattern
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Existing rebellion shapes upbringing and succession so that a new child emerges inside the same moral trajectory.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: childbirth (`quranic:root_001683:B003/m01`); child and descendant (`quranic:root_001683:B001/m01`); derivative generated from a prior source (`quranic:root_001683:B005/m01`); new generation within a people (`quranic:root_001465:B003/m01`); human upbringing (`quranic:root_001465:B006/m01`); low and debased growth (`quranic:root_001465:B008/m01`); following and imitation (`quranic:root_000175:B001/m01`); uninterrupted succession (`quranic:root_000175:B004/m01`); departure from obedience (`quranic:root_001022:B001/m01`); transgressive rupture (`quranic:root_001132:B004/m01`); denial of truth (`quranic:root_001307:B003/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Biology supplies continuity, but following and upbringing give that continuity direction. The child is a derivative in both bodily and social senses, so entrenched rebellion can enter the next generation before it appears as an independent choice.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Parental and foster care can redirect formation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Parents and caregivers sustain a developing child through gradual repair, nourishment, and responsible oversight.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: father and mother as sources of birth (`quranic:root_001683:B002/m01`); young child (`quranic:root_001683:B004/m01`); same-age peer (`quranic:root_001683:B006/m01`); gradual repair and upbringing (`quranic:root_000532:B002/m01`); lordly care and ownership (`quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`); human growth and education (`quranic:root_001465:B006/m01`); liability that follows an act (`quranic:root_000175:B006/m01`); household and dependents (`quranic:root_000166:B002/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Upbringing is a role-governed process: parent, child, peer, caregiver, household, and responsibility all participate. The same lineage that can transmit corruption therefore contains a mechanism for guided formation, which is why moral inheritance is not biologically fixed.

facets.statement: Bir varlığın sayı, miktar veya ölçü bakımından çok olmayışıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yükü taşıma veya taşıyabilme ile öznenin yükselip harekete geçmesini aynı kolda açıkça toplar; kuşun uçuşa kalkması, göğün yükselmesi ve yolcuların yüklenip ayrılması ayrı katılımcı gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Taşıma, yükselme ve yüklenerek yola koyulma bu kolun sınırıdır; salt sayısal azlık bu anlamlara katılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yük taşıma ile yükselme çekirdek çizgileri ayrılır; ağır bulut taşıma, uçuşa kalkma ve yolcuların ayrılması yalnızca kendi özne ve yapılarında geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir yükü kaldırıp taşıyabilmeyi veya üstlenmeyi ve bir öznenin yükselerek harekete geçmesini bildirir. İkinci çizgi kuşun uçuşa kalkmasını, göğün yükselmesini ve yolcuların yüklenip yola koyulmasını kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi kaldıracak gücü bulmak, onu taşımak veya yük olarak üstlenmektir.
Bir öznenin aşağıdaki konumundan yükselmesi veya kuş gibi harekete ve uçuşa başlamasıdır.
Yolcuların yüklerini alıp bulundukları yerden ayrılarak yolculuğa başlamasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar bir yükü kaldırıp taşıma ile yukarı kalkarak harekete geçme çizgilerini bir araya getirir; kuş, gök, bulut ve yolcu örnekleri katılımcıya göre bu iki çizgiyi somutlaştırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kişiyi korku veya öfke yüzünden tutan titreme ve silkinişi açıkça tanımlar; genel hareket kararsızlığı değil, duygusal tetikleyicisi bulunan bedensel bir sarsıntı söz konusudur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol insanda korku veya öfkeyle beliren titremeyle sınırlıdır; nesnelerin genel sallanma ve yerinde duramama hali ayrı koldadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Duygudan doğan titreme temel addır; kişiyi titremenin tutması ve öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi yalnızca ilgili yapılara bağlı anlatımlardır.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın korku veya öfke yüzünden titremesi, ürpermesi ya da bedensel olarak silkelenmesidir. Durum, kişiyi bir titreme nöbetinin tutması veya öfkenin titremeyle dışa vurulması biçiminde anlatılabilir.

facets.statement: İnsan bedeninde beliren titreme, ürperti veya istemsiz silkiniş halidir.
Titremenin belirleyici nedeni korku ya da öfkedir.
Belirli yapılarda titremenin kişiyi tutması veya kişinin öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar insandaki titreme ve silkinişte birleşir; korku ile öfke başlıca nedenlerdir ve durum hem kişiyi tutan bir nöbet hem öfkenin bedensel belirtisi olarak anlatılır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الرب: الله تبارك وتعالى؛ ورب كل شيء مالكه (jamhara); رب كل شئ: مالكه؛ وقد قالوه في الجاهلية للملك؛ رببت القوم: سستهم (sihah); يكون الرب: المالك؛ ويكون الرب: السيد المطاع؛ ويكون الرب: المصلح (tahdhib); الرب مصدر مستعار للفاعل؛ لا يقال الرب مطلقا إلا لله؛ رب الدار ورب الفرس (mufradat); فالرب المالك والخالق والصاحب؛ والله جل ثناؤه الرب (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, bir şeyi gözeterek düzeltme, geliştirme ve aşama aşama tamamlanmış duruma getirme sürecini tutarlı biçimde gösterir. Çocuk yetiştirme, mülkü iyileştirme ve yapılan iyiliği tamamlama bu sürecin farklı nesneleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız bakım göstermeyi değil, gözetilen şeyi zaman içinde düzeltip tamamlamayı gerektirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Eylemin yalın gelişim çekirdeği ile çocuk, mülk ve yapılan iyilik gibi nesnelere bağlı kullanımları ayrıştırılarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi sürekli gözetim altında düzeltmek, geliştirmek ve aşama aşama tamamlanmış durumuna ulaştırmaktır.

facets.statement: Süreç, gözetilen şeyi eksik durumdan tamamlanmış duruma doğru geliştirir.
Çocuk yetiştirme, bir mülkü iyileştirme ve yapılan iyiliği tamamlama başlıca uygulamalardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar düzeltme, sürekli bakım, yetiştirme ve tamamlama öğelerini tek bir aşamalı gelişim sürecinde birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bakımın gelişme, düzeltme ve tamamlanma sonucuna yöneldiği bütün genel bağlamlarda kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Aşamalı gelişim, bakım, düzeltme ve tamamlanma öğelerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir çocuğun veya canlı varlığın gelişimini üstlenme bağlamında doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Sürekli bakım yoluyla gelişip olgunlaştırma sürecini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Mülk, iş veya yapılan iyilik gibi bir nesneyi eksiksiz duruma getirme bağlamında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Düzeltme ve tamamlanmış duruma ulaştırma sonucunu korur.
Gözetim ve ilgilenme yönünü kısmen korur.
error_profile.loses: Düzeltme, aşamalı geliştirme ve tamamlanmış duruma ulaştırma sonucunu kaybeder.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Gözetilen şeyi aşama aşama geliştirme ve tamamlanmış duruma ulaştırma sonucu odak dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Aralıklı yoklama, öğüt verme ve çevresel bakım gibi tamamlanma gerektirmeyen kullanımlar komşuda bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir şeyin bakımını üstlenme, onu düzeltme ve iyi durumda tutma alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal gelişim sürecini tamamlanma sınırına taşır; komşu dal ise bakımın yinelenmesini ve gözetimi sonuçtan bağımsız olarak kapsar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; bakım ile tamamlama arasındaki en ince sınırı gösteren aday seçildi, yalnız büyüme, akrabalık veya olgunluk alanını paylaşanlar dışarıda bırakıldı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه رب الشيء إذا أصلحه وأتمه وقام عليه، ورب النعمة والصنيعة والضيعة والولد والصبي، والتربية حالا فحالا
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليست السيادة المجردة بلا معنى الإصلاح، ولا القرابة الربيبة نفسها
branches.source_phrase_ar: رب الرجل النعمة يربها ربا؛ ربابة أيضا إذا تممها (jamhara); رب الضيعة أي أصلحها وأتمها؛ رب فلان ولده؛ رباه (sihah); رب الشيء أي أصلحه؛ رب فلان الصنيعة إذا أتمها وأصلحها (tahdhib); التربية، وهو إنشاء الشيء حالا فحالا إلى حد التمام؛ ربه ورباه ورببه (mufradat); رب فلان ضيعته إذا قام على إصلاحها؛ رببت الصبي أربه (maqayis); ربته تربيتا إذا رببه (maqayis-rbt)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, Tanrı bilgisiyle donanmış, dinî hükümleri bilen, bilgeliği olan ve başkalarını temel bilgilerden başlayarak yetiştiren bilgin tipini ortak bir kimlikte birleştirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal sıradan bilgi sahipliğini değil, Tanrı bilgisi, dinî uzmanlık ve öğretici yetiştirme görevini birlikte taşır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan tanıklanan bilgin ve öğretici kişi anlamıyla sınırlıdır; başka yapılardan anlam aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Tanrı bilgisine ve dinî hükümlere hâkim, bilgece davranan ve insanları temel bilgiden ileri bilgiye doğru yetiştiren bilgindir.

facets.statement: Kişi Tanrı bilgisiyle ve dinî konulardaki sağlam bilgisiyle tanımlanır.
Bilgiyi yalnız taşımakla kalmaz, başkalarını küçük adımlarla öğretip yetiştirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar Tanrı'yı bilme, dinî hükümleri kavrama, bilgelik ve aşamalı öğreticilik özelliklerini aynı bilgin kişide bir araya getirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dinî bilgi, bilgelik ve öğretici yetiştiricilik özelliklerinin birlikte vurgulandığı kişi için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Tanrı bilgisi, bilginlik ve aşamalı öğreticilik öğelerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin dinî uzmanlığı ile insan yetiştirme görevini birlikte anlatan bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dinî uzmanlık ve öğretici yetiştirme görevini birlikte korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: Tanrı bilgisine sahip bilgin ve öğretici

error_profile.preserves: Bilgi sahibi olma yönünü genel olarak korur.
error_profile.loses: Tanrı bilgisi, dinî sınır ve insanları aşama aşama yetiştirme görevini kaybeder.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tanrı bilgisi ve insanları temel bilgilerden başlayarak yetiştirme görevi odak dalda belirleyicidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Dinî hukuk hükümlerinde uzmanlaşma komşu dalın daha dar mesleki sınırıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da dinî hükümleri bilen ve bu alanda yetkin sayılan bilgini gösterebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal dinî bilgiyi Tanrı bilgisi, bilgelik ve öğreticilikle genişletir; komşu dal ise özellikle dinî hukuk bilgisinde uzmanlaşır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; dinî uzmanlık ile öğretici bilgin kimliği arasındaki sınırı en açık gösteren aday seçildi, yalnız bilgelik veya saygınlık bildiren adaylar elendi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الرباني والربانيون بمعنى العلماء والحكماء وأهل العلم بالرب أو من يرب العلم ونفسه به
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الربيون إذا أريد بهم الألوف والجماعات، ولا ربان الملاحين
branches.source_phrase_ar: الرباني: المتأله العارف بالله تعالى (sihah); الرباني: العالم؛ العلماء بالحلال والحرام؛ حكماء علماء؛ العالم المعلم الذي يغذو الناس بصغار العلوم (tahdhib); الرباني... يرب العلم؛ يرب نفسه بالعلم؛ منسوب إلى الرب (mufradat); الربي العارف بالرب (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, çok sayıdaki insanın bir topluluk oluşturması ve ayrı kabilelerin tek bir birlik hâlinde toplanması çekirdeğini destekler. Sayı değeri ve belirli kabile birliği bu çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: İnsan topluluğu anlamı, yalnız herhangi bir çoğulluğu değil büyük sayı veya fiilî birleşme niteliğini taşır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan tanıklanan büyük insan topluluğu ve birleşmiş kabileler alanında kalır; hayvan sürüsü anlamı bu dala genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Çok sayıda insanın bir araya gelmesiyle oluşan büyük topluluk ya da ayrı kabilelerin ortak bir birlik hâlinde birleşmesidir.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, insanların büyük sayıda bir araya gelerek topluluk oluşturmasıdır.
On bin kişilik topluluk ve beş kabilenin tek birlik olması tanıklanan özel örneklerdir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar binlerce kişilik toplulukları, on bin kişilik bir sayıyı ve birleşmiş kabileleri büyük sayı ile toplanma ortaklığında birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Çok sayıda insanın ya da birleşmiş kabilelerin oluşturduğu topluluğu genel olarak anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: İnsanlardan oluşma, büyüklük ve bir araya gelme çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ayrı kabilelerin tek bir ortak birlik oluşturduğu tarihsel topluluk bağlamında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kabilelerin toplanıp tek birlik oluşturması yönünü korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: büyük topluluk; on bin kişilik topluluk
tek birlik hâlinde birleşmiş beş kabile
insanları toplayan kişi veya toplanma yeri

error_profile.preserves: İnsan sayısının çokluğu yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Birleşmiş kabileler ile düzenli topluluk oluşturma ilişkisini kaybeder.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Çok büyük sayı ve ayrı kabilelerin tek birlik oluşturması odak dalın belirgin sınırıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Karışık unsurlar, ordu ve genel toplama sonucu oluşan birlikler komşu dalda daha geniş yer tutar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da insanların bir araya gelmesiyle oluşan topluluğu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal büyük sayı ile kabile birliğini öne çıkarır; komşu dal ise sayı veya kabile koşulu olmadan her türlü toplanmış grubu kapsar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel topluluk ile büyük ve birleşmiş topluluk arasındaki sınırı en iyi gösteren aday seçildi, öteki yakın grup adları tekrara düşmemek için alınmadı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الربة والجماعات الكثيرة، والربيون إذا فسروا بالألوف أو الجماعات، ورباب القبائل لاجتماعهم

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, önceki bir eşten olan çocuk ile o çocuğun bakımını üstlenen yeni eş arasındaki karşılıklı aile bağını destekler. Aynı dişil biçimin bakıcı kadın ve evde süt için beslenen hayvan anlamları da bulunduğundan bağlam ayrımı zorunludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Üvey çocuk, üvey ebeveyn ve bakıcı anlamları karşılıklı bakım ilişkisine bağlıdır; genel yetiştirme anlamıyla karıştırılmamalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız tanıklanan aile ve bakım rolleriyle sınırlıdır; genel bakım veya yetiştirme eylemi bu kişi adlarına taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Önceki bir eşten olan çocuk ile o çocuğun bakımını üstlenen yeni eş arasında kurulan üvey aile ve yetiştirme ilişkisidir. Bazı kullanımlarda bakıcı kadın ya da evde beslenen dişi hayvan da aynı bakım bağıyla adlandırılır.

facets.statement: Çocuk ve yeni eş, biyolojik olmayan fakat bakım üstlenilen aile ilişkisiyle birbirine bağlanır.
Bakıcı kadın ve evde sütü için beslenen dişi hayvan, bakım ilişkisine dayanan genişlemiş kullanımlardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar üvey oğul ve kız ile annenin eşi veya babanın eşini karşılıklı bakım ilişkisi içinde açıklar; bakıcı kadın anlamını da bu çerçeveye ekler.

concept_gloss.applicability: Çocuk ile biyolojik olmayan bakımı üstlenen eş arasındaki karşılıklı aile ilişkisini anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Üvey aile rolü ile bakım üstlenme ilişkisini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Eşin önceki birlikteliğinden olan oğul veya kız çocuğu için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Çocuğun yeni eşle kurduğu biyolojik olmayan aile bağını korur.

error_profile.preserves: Yeni eşin çocuk üzerindeki aile ve bakım rolünü korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Üvey çocuk ile annenin veya babanın yeni eşi arasındaki karşılıklı akrabalık rolleri odak dala özgüdür.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; bakım üstlenme ile üvey aile rolü arasındaki sınırı açıklayan aday seçildi, yalnız çocuk, hane veya genel koruma alanını paylaşanlar yayımlanmadı.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, koyulaşmış meyve özü veya yağ tortusu olan bir maddeyi ve bu maddeyle deri kap, yiyecek ya da ilacın işlenip güçlendirilmesini tutarlı biçimde bir araya getirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Maddenin kendisi ile o madde kullanılarak işlenmiş nesne ayrıdır; sahiplik ve yönetim anlamları bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan koyu öz veya tortu ile onun kullanıldığı işleme alanında kalır; benzer sesli sahiplik anlamına genişlemez.

concept_map.definition: Meyveden koyulaştırılmış öz ya da yağın koyu tortusudur; ayrıca deri kap, yiyecek veya ilaç bu madde sürülerek ya da katılarak işlenip güçlendirilir.

facets.statement: Temel madde koyu bir meyve özü veya yağın dibinde kalan koyu tortudur.
Deri, kap, yiyecek ve ilaç bu maddeyle işlenir, sağlamlaştırılır veya hazırlanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar koyu öz ve yağ tortusu anlamını, deri kapların güçlendirilmesi ile yiyecek ve ilaçların bu maddeyle hazırlanması kullanımına bağlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Maddenin kendisini ve ondan hareketle yapılan işleme uygulamalarını kapsayan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Koyulaşmış öz ile yağ tortusu seçeneklerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Üzüm veya başka meyvelerden koyulaştırılmış özün söz konusu olduğu yiyecek bağlamında uygundur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Deri kap, yiyecek veya ilacın koyu öz kullanılarak hazırlandığı bağlamda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Maddeyle işleme ve sağlamlaştırma ilişkisini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: koyu meyve özü veya yağ tortusu

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Meyve özü veya yağ tortusuyla deri, kap, yiyecek ve ilacı işleyip güçlendirme odak dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Erimiş metal, irin, katran suyu ve ekmek döküntüsü gibi çok çeşitli maddeler komşu dalda bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da yağın koyu tortusu veya yoğun bir çökeltiyi adlandırabilir.
